title: the hand-over takes 30 seconds, not 35 minutes

criteria.text:
`node checks/leg7-handover.cjs` exits `0`, with every case passing against throwaway roots and a
  fake `paseo` binary — released dispatches, live lease not pre-empted, stale dispatches, a future
  `nextTickAt` suppresses and a past one fires, and the floor holds.

In the daemon, `nextTickAt` appears in `~/.paseo-steward.json` for every enabled project, and a
  stale project is dispatched at the first beat at or after `lastDispatchAt + 2 min` — **≤ 150 s** — with a
  `[paseo-steward] wheel (…)` line in
  `paseo plugin logs` — the log line, not `tick.running`, because that flag is in-process state a reload
  resets.

The released-lease rule is written into `control/COMMAND.md`, because a protocol the successor
  does not read is not a protocol.

retired: Superseded by LEG 10: the owner ruled that a claimed lease is a steward, so the released/stale dispatch triggers this check tested no longer exist. Its surviving properties (the persisted floor, the persisted schedule) are asserted in checks/leg9-lazy.cjs and checks/leg10-takeover.cjs.

title: the acceptance runner: a manifest, a scope diff and a gate, in one command

criteria.text:
`node checks/accept.cjs <leg>` exits `0` for a leg whose commands all pass, and writes
  `checks/out/<leg>-<sha>.json` whose `sha` equals `git rev-parse HEAD` at run time.

The negative control exists and fails: a registry entry whose declared command exits non-zero
  produces `verdict: "rejected"` and process exit `1`, through the identical code path; an unknown leg id
  exits `2`. A check that cannot fail is not a check.

The artifact records, per command, the command string, its exit code and its duration, and records
  the leg's declared write set beside the files actually changed (`git diff --name-only <base>..HEAD`).
  A missing or unreadable `base` is recorded as a reason, not silently skipped.

`npx tsc --noEmit` exits `0` and `node checks/leg7-handover.cjs` still exits `0` — no regression
  in the checks an earlier leg established.

Write set confined to `checks/**`, `paseo.json`, `plan.md`, `STATUS.md`, `docs/leg8-2026-10-19.md`.
  `control/COMMAND.md` untouched, not staged, never `git add -A`.

recovered: 2026-10-20: this entry was never written when the leg landed, so checks/leg8-registry.cjs had been failing since 2026-10-19 and a `$?`-after-command-substitution bug in the steward's suite loop hid it. The check was right; the registry was wrong.

title: 懒人模式: unattended progression, and a running session outranks every timer

criteria.text:
`node checks/leg9-lazy.cjs` exits `0`: OFF dispatches nothing, ON hands over, a RUNNING session
  blocks a second one however stale its heartbeat, the same lease dispatches once the session is gone, the
  floor survives a fresh module, a finished worker wakes the same session with `steer`, and the steward's own
  turn does not wake itself.
`node checks/leg7-handover.cjs` and `npx tsc --noEmit` exit `0`; reload reaches `Plugin ready`.

In the daemon, a real worker's `turn_ended` produces one `[paseo-steward] lazy: woke steward …` line
  and **no new agent appears** — the wake must not cost an agent.

The button and its hint live in the popover; every string in `client/strings.ts`; disabled without a
  workspace.

Write set confined to the declared list; `plan.md`, `STATUS.md`, `OVERVIEW.md` and
  `control/COMMAND.md` updated.

title: 接管 and the capitalist rule: a claimed lease is a steward, and idle slots are waste

criteria.text: `node checks/leg10-takeover.cjs` exits 0: a claimed lease is a steward however old the heartbeat; a released block starts nobody while an agent is claimed; 接管 starts exactly one steward when there is no claim or the claimed agent is gone; the persisted floor holds; the capitalist poke fires once per five minutes and never when the Ready queue is empty; a worker's finish wakes the same steward session and the steward's own turn does not.
`checks/leg9-lazy.cjs`, `checks/leg7-handover.cjs` and `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0; reload reaches `Plugin ready`.
The pill and the screen read 在岗 / 无主管 / 主管已不在 from the claim, not from heartbeat age. An old heartbeat is a detail line, never a status.
Write set confined to the declared list.
